items.requirement: Gold purity: confirm the karat (10K, 14K, 18K, etc.)
items.note: Recorded from each listing's metal field; the exact quote is stored per row. This is the seller's claim, not a test result.

items.requirement: Solid gold: the listing must explicitly say solid gold — not plated, vermeil, filled, overlay or tone
items.note: Blue Nile, Brilliant Earth and Ross-Simons list karat only. Flagged F-006; get written confirmation from the seller before paying.

items.requirement: Hallmark: a 10K/14K/18K stamp plus a maker's/manufacturer's mark
items.note: Flagged F-005. Must be seen on the ring or in a close-up photo, then confirmed by an independent jeweler.

items.requirement: Weight: the ring's weight in grams
items.note: Flagged F-004. Where a seller publishes grams it is recorded; everywhere else it is blank and must be requested in writing.

items.requirement: Seller reputation: independent reviews/complaints and real contact information
items.note: No review rating is republished here. Mejuri's contact details were not captured (F-011) and Costco's were only partial; BBB search links are provided for manual review.

items.requirement: Price: compare with gold weight and current gold value; an unusually cheap price is a red flag
items.note: Computable only where a weight exists. Setting-only prices also exclude the centre stone (F-015), so they cannot be compared with complete-ring prices.

items.requirement: Return policy, including exclusions for resized/custom rings
items.note: Blue Nile, Brilliant Earth and Ross-Simons explicitly exclude resized or altered rings; Mejuri and Costco do not state it. Costco additionally lists precious metals as non-refundable — see the critical flag F-009.

items.requirement: Payment: prefer a credit card; avoid irreversible methods
items.note: Financing is advertised by several sellers, but no seller's full accepted-card list was captured. Pay by credit card at checkout so chargeback protection applies.

items.requirement: Documentation: keep the listing, receipt, description and purity claims
items.note: Every row links to the official page with a capture date and the quoted text. Save a PDF of the live page at purchase time — pages change (F-002, F-016).

items.requirement: On arrival: independent jeweler verifies purity and weight before wearing/resizing
items.note: Resizing or engraving can void the return window, so inspect first, before anyone touches the ring.

items.requirement: Best verification: XRF testing or another professional purity test; do not rely on the stamp alone
items.note: Ask for the XRF readout in writing, including the machine's calibration check.

items.requirement: If the seller will not allow independent verification or a return, do not buy
items.note: Currently triggered by Costco until the non-refundable precious-metals clause is resolved in writing (F-009).
